name: ClickFunnels
category: Funnel builder with courses, store, community and email marketing
oneLiner: Funnel, store, course and email platform sold in four tiers priced by workspaces, team seats and contacts, with no percentage-of-sales fee.
summary: ClickFunnels bundles a drag-and-drop funnel and website builder, an online store, courses, community, email/automation tools and a CRM into one platform, sold as four tiers (Launch, Scale, Optimize, Dominate) that scale by workspace count, team-member seats and contact limits. Launch, Scale and Optimize can be billed monthly or annually; Dominate is sold annually only. ClickFunnels takes no percentage of sales; card payments run through Stripe or its own Payments AI gateway at each processor's standard rate.
notFor: Sellers who want a free-forever tier to start with, since the cheapest plan runs $81-97/month with no ongoing free plan
Teams needing more than 20 team-member seats or 400,000 contacts without a custom/enterprise conversation
Buyers who need the exact free-trial terms (length, card requirement) confirmed up front, since ClickFunnels does not state them plainly on its current pricing or signup pages
pros: No percentage-of-sales fee on any plan ("you'll keep every penny you make")
Same base card-processing rate, 2.9% + $0.30, on both supported gateways (Stripe and Payments AI), with no ClickFunnels markup on top
Sub-account "Workspaces" scale from 1 (Launch) to 20 (Dominate), letting an agency run multiple client accounts under one subscription
Online courses (3 to 20, by plan), a store, community and email/automation tools are bundled in every tier rather than sold as separate add-ons
Monthly billing is available on Launch, Scale and Optimize, with no forced annual commitment except on the top Dominate plan
30-day money-back guarantee on payments, and plans can be changed at any time
cons: Contact limits are tight at the entry tier: Launch caps out at 10,000 contacts and 50,000 emails/month
Team-member seats are capped per plan (2/5/10/20) with no published add-on price to buy extra seats without upgrading the whole plan
Dominate, the only plan above 150,000 contacts or 10 team members, is sold annually only at $5,997/year with no month-to-month option
The pricing page markets "Unlimited Funnels" on every plan but flags it "Limited Time," so the funnel count is not guaranteed to stay unlimited
Free-trial length and card requirement are not stated on the current pricing or signup pages
